title: Harry Potter/Minecraft/Gold Train Easter Eggs
description: At the train tunnel covered in debris, there will be text on the wall saying 9 and 3/4 that you can walk through, a reference to Harry Potter. After walking through the wall, you'll need to break some blocks - a reference to Minecraft. Finally, you'll find a golden train - a reference to the Nazi gold train urban legend.

title: Terminator Easter Egg
description: Workshop with the Easter Egg is located behind the wirefence house, next to the two lions statues. Gain access to the workshop by restoring power to it, using generator in a tool shed next to it. Tool shed is accessed via vent hole on the Northern side of the shed (you'll need to tear off the grating).

title: Helipad & Multiple NPCs
description: CONTAINS SPOILERS Location: Requires mods to reach, as it is outside the playable area and is surrounded by a damage barrier that instantly kills the player. Loot: Various weapons, ammo, and med kits. Notes: During normal gameplay, the only time this location is accessed is during the final section of the final story quest, [The Last Supper](). On the helipad are NPCs of Aiden, Lydia, and the beast version of the Baron. Although all three are in idle animations, they are static and do not react to anything.
